step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture describes a genomics data processing pipeline. Initial genomic data ('ATCG 100's 1000's') is ingested into ad-hoc EC2 VMs. This ingested data is then written to an FSx file system. For scalable processing, versioned container images are stored in ECR. These containers are pulled by EKS clusters, which also mount the FSx file system to access the raw data. EKS performs the data curation, transforming raw genomic data into matrices. The output of this curation process is stored in a Data Lake, visually represented by an S3 bucket icon and referred to as 'DATA LAKE'. Finally, data scientists and biologists consume the curated data from the Data Lake for statistical analysis and research.

graph.name: Biopharma Genomics Data Processing Pipeline
graph.categories: Genomics, Data Processing, Analytics, Research & Development
graph.notes: Architecture for ingesting, curating, and analyzing genomics data using EC2, FSx, ECR, EKS, and S3 for a data lake. Emphasizes scalability and version control for reproducibility.

nodes.name: Genomic Data (ATCG)
nodes.notes: Initial genomic data stream (hundreds to thousands of samples, hundreds of billions of ATCs and Gs).

nodes.name: Ad-hoc EC2 VMs
nodes.notes: Used for initial ingestion of raw genomic data.

nodes.name: FSx
nodes.notes: Stores the ingested genomic data, which is then mounted by EKS for processing.

nodes.name: ECR (Container Repository)
nodes.notes: Stores versioned container images for pipeline execution, enabling reproducible science.

nodes.name: EKS Cluster
nodes.notes: Scalable Kubernetes cluster for curating genomic data, pulls containers from ECR, mounts FSx, and leverages Auto Scaling for dynamic scaling (zero to hundreds of instances).

nodes.name: DATA LAKE
nodes.notes: An S3-based Data Lake that stores curated genomic data (matrices) for downstream users.

nodes.name: Data Scientists / Biologists
nodes.notes: Downstream users who perform statistical analyses and scientific reasoning over the curated data from the Data Lake.

edges.notes: Raw genomic data is ingested into ad-hoc EC2 virtual machines.
Ingested data from EC2 VMs is written to the FSx file system.
EKS pulls versioned container images (representing processing pipelines) from ECR.
The EKS cluster mounts FSx to access the ingested genomic data for curation processes.
EKS writes the curated genomic data (matrices) as output to the S3-based Data Lake.
Data Scientists and Biologists consume the curated data from the Data Lake for analysis.
